name: NullReferenceException
explanation: Your program tried to use an object that has no value (null).
cause: The object was never created or was set to null before being used.
solution: Create the object with new before using it.
Check for null before use: if (user != null).
beginner: A variable is like a box. Your program tried to open the box, but nothing is inside yet.

name: IndexOutOfRangeException
keywords: Index was outside the bounds of the array
explanation: You asked for an array position that does not exist.
cause: The index is negative or is >= the array length. Arrays start at 0.
beginner: If a shelf has 3 slots (0,1,2), asking for slot 3 finds nothing.

name: InvalidOperationException
explanation: An operation was not allowed in the object's current state.
cause: Common causes: First() on an empty list, or changing a collection while looping over it.
solution: Use FirstOrDefault() and check the result.
Do not add/remove items inside foreach; loop over a copy (ToList()).
beginner: It's like pressing 'play' on an empty playlist: the action is valid, but not right now.

name: FormatException
keywords: Input string was not in a correct format
explanation: Text could not be converted to the requested type.
cause: Something like int.Parse("abc") was used on text that is not a valid number.
solution: Use int.TryParse and check the result.
Trim and validate user input first.
beginner: You asked the program to read the word 'apple' as a number.

name: NullPointerException
explanation: Your code used a reference that points to nothing (null).
cause: The object was not initialized, or a method returned null.
solution: Use Optional for values that may be missing.
beginner: A phone number written on paper that is blank: there is nobody to call.

name: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
explanation: You used an array position outside the array size.
cause: The index is negative or >= array.length.
solution: Print the index and length to debug.
beginner: Asking for seat 10 in a room with only 5 seats.

name: ClassCastException
explanation: An object was cast to a type it is not.
cause: The object's real type is different from the type you cast it to.
example: if (obj instanceof String) { String s = (String) obj; }
beginner: Trying to treat a cat as if it were a dog.

name: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined
explanation: You tried to read a property from a value that is undefined.
cause: The variable was never assigned, an API/array item is missing, or a name is misspelled.
solution: Log the variable to see what it holds.
beginner: You asked an empty box for what is inside it.

name: ReferenceError
explanation: You used a variable or function that does not exist in this scope.
cause: Typo in the name, missing declaration (let/const), or it is out of scope.
solution: Declare the variable before using it.
Make sure the script that defines it loads first.
beginner: Calling a friend whose name isn't in your phone.

name: SyntaxError
explanation: The code is not written in valid JavaScript.
cause: A missing bracket, quote, comma, or parenthesis.
solution: Look at the line number in the error and the line above.
Check every ( { [ and quote is closed.
Use an editor with bracket matching.
beginner: It's a sentence with grammar the computer can't read.

name: TypeError: is not a function
explanation: You tried to call something that is not a function.
cause: Wrong method name, or the value is another type (e.g. calling map on an object).
solution: Check the spelling of the method.
Confirm it is the type you expect (array vs object).
beginner: Trying to 'drive' a bicycle: the name is right but the thing is wrong.

name: NameError
explanation: Python found a name it does not know.
cause: Typo, or the variable was used before it was created.
solution: Assign the variable before using it.
beginner: Using a nickname before telling anyone who it belongs to.

name: TypeError
explanation: An operation used values of the wrong type.
cause: For example adding a string and a number: 'Age: ' + 5.
solution: Convert with str(), int() or float().
beginner: You can't add apples and the word 'banana'.

name: IndexError
explanation: You asked for a list position that does not exist.
cause: The index is >= len(list) or the list is empty.
solution: Loop with for item in my_list.
beginner: A 3-item list has positions 0-2; position 3 does not exist.

name: KeyError
explanation: You looked up a dictionary key that is not there.
cause: The key is misspelled or was never added.
beginner: Looking up a word in a dictionary that has no such entry.

name: AttributeError
explanation: You used an attribute or method the object does not have.
cause: Wrong name, wrong type, or the value is None.
solution: If it is None, find why the value was not set.
beginner: Asking a toaster to play music.

name: SyntaxError
explanation: Python cannot read the line as valid code.
cause: Missing colon, quote or bracket, or wrong keyword.
solution: Check the reported line and the one above.
beginner: Like a sentence missing punctuation.

name: IndentationError
explanation: Python's spacing at the start of a line is wrong.
cause: Mixed tabs/spaces or a block with no indented body.
solution: Do not mix tabs and spaces.
beginner: Python uses spacing to know which lines belong together.

name: SQL syntax error
keywords: You have an error in your SQL syntax
explanation: The database could not understand your SQL statement.
cause: A missing comma, keyword, quote, or misplaced clause.
solution: Look at the text after 'near' in the message.
Keep order: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY.
example: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active = 1;
beginner: Like giving a librarian a request in the wrong word order.

name: Invalid object name
explanation: The table or view you named was not found.
cause: Typo, wrong database/schema, or the table was never created.
solution: Confirm the right database is selected.
beginner: Asking for a file in a folder that doesn't exist.

name: Column not found
explanation: A column in your query does not exist in that table.
cause: Typo, or the column is in another table.
beginner: Asking for a page number that isn't in the book.

name: Duplicate key
explanation: You tried to insert a value that must be unique but already exists.
cause: A row with the same primary/unique key is already there.
solution: SELECT first to see if it exists.
beginner: Two students can't have the same student number.

name: Missing closing tag
explanation: An HTML element was opened but never closed.
cause:
A
,

or similar has no matching closing tag.
beginner: Like opening a bracket in a sentence and never closing it.

name: CSS syntax error
explanation: The browser could not read a CSS rule.
cause: A missing semicolon, colon or brace, or a misspelled property.
beginner: The browser skips lines it can't read.

name: Invalid selector
explanation: The selector you wrote is not valid CSS.
cause: Wrong symbols, e.g. missing . for a class or # for an id.
solution: Do not start a class name with a digit.
beginner: A selector is an address; a wrong address finds no house.

name: Too many re-renders
explanation: React kept re-rendering in an endless loop.
cause: State is set during render, or an event handler is written like onClick={setX(1)} so it runs immediately.
solution: Pass a function to handlers: onClick={() => setCount(1)}.
Never call setState directly in the component body.
Put updates in useEffect with the right dependency array.
beginner: Like a light switch that flips itself on and off forever.

name: Invalid hook call
keywords: Hooks can only be called inside
explanation: A React Hook was used somewhere React does not allow.
cause: The hook is inside a loop, condition or normal function, or there are two copies of React installed.
solution: Call hooks only at the top level of a component or custom hook.
Run npm ls react to look for duplicate copies.
beginner: Hooks are reserved seats: they must be requested in the same order every time.

name: Missing key prop
keywords: Each child in a list should have a unique
explanation: React needs a unique key on every item in a list.
cause: A list was rendered with .map() without a key.
solution: Add key={item.id} to the outermost element inside map.
Use a stable id; avoid the array index if the list can change.
beginner: Name tags at a party help React know who is who.

name: Objects are not valid as a React child
keywords: Objects are not valid as a React child
explanation: You tried to display a whole object inside JSX.
cause: Something like {user} where user is an object.
solution: Use .map() to render arrays of objects.
beginner: Trying to print a filing cabinet on one line; pick one folder.

name: Hydration failed
keywords: Text content does not match server-rendered
explanation: The HTML from the server differs from what the browser rendered.
cause: Date.now(), Math.random(), window or localStorage used during the first render, or invalid HTML nesting.
solution: Avoid random or time values in the first render.
beginner: Two people describing the same room differently.

name: Adjacent JSX elements
keywords: Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped
explanation: A component can return only one root element.
cause: Two sibling elements are returned without a wrapper.
beginner: A parcel must be sent in one box.

name: TS2322 Type not assignable
explanation: You put a value of one type where another type is expected.
cause: For example a string assigned to a number variable.
beginner: Putting a square peg in a round hole.

name: TS2339 Property does not exist
explanation: You used a property that TypeScript doesn't know is on that type.
cause: Typo, or the type or interface is missing that property.
solution: Add the property to the interface.
Narrow the type first (if ('name' in obj)).
example: interface User { name: string; age: number }
beginner: Asking a book for its battery level.

name: TS7006 Implicit any
explanation: TypeScript can't work out a type and strict mode forbids 'any'.
cause: A parameter or variable has no type.
solution: Give the variable an initial value.
beginner: A label is missing on a box, and the rules say every box needs one.

name: TS2345 Argument type
explanation: A function received an argument of the wrong type.
cause: The value passed doesn't match the parameter type.
solution: Convert or fix the value you pass.
beginner: Handing a ticket to a machine that only accepts coins.

name: Object is possibly undefined
explanation: The value may be missing, and you used it without checking.
cause: Strict null checks are on.
beginner: Opening a box that might be empty.

name: Unhandled promise rejection
explanation: A promise failed and nothing handled the failure.
cause: A fetch or async call threw an error and there is no catch.
solution: Check the network tab for the real error.
beginner: Ordering food and nobody answers the phone when it fails.

name: CORS error
explanation: The browser blocked a request to another website.
cause: The server didn't say your site is allowed to call it.
solution: Enable CORS on the server for your origin.
Call your own backend, which calls the other API.
beginner: A building's security guard not on the guest list.

name: JSON parse error
explanation: JSON.parse was given text that isn't valid JSON.
cause: Often the server returned an HTML error page or empty text.
solution: Log the raw response text first.
Check the URL and status code.
beginner: Reading a letter in a language you don't speak.

name: Assignment to constant variable
explanation: You tried to change a const variable.
cause: const variables can't be reassigned.
solution: Use let if the value changes.
Or change a property (allowed on const objects).
beginner: A label glued to a jar that can't be moved.

name: Maximum call stack size exceeded
explanation: A function called itself too many times.
cause: Recursion without a stopping condition.
solution: Add a base case that returns.
Make sure each call moves toward it.
beginner: Mirrors facing each other: it never ends.

name: ModuleNotFoundError
explanation: Python can't find the module you imported.
cause: It isn't installed, the name is wrong, or the wrong environment is active.
beginner: Looking for a book the library doesn't have.

name: ZeroDivisionError
explanation: You divided a number by zero.
cause: The divisor was 0.
beginner: Sharing pizza among zero people.

name: ValueError
explanation: The value has the right type but an unusable content.
cause: For example int('abc').
beginner: Asking for 'blue' when you needed a number.

name: OutOfMemoryError
explanation: Java ran out of memory.
cause: Too much data loaded at once, or objects never released.
solution: Look for lists that keep growing.
beginner: Pouring a bucket into a cup.

name: Cannot find symbol
explanation: The compiler doesn't know a name you used.
cause: Typo, missing import or missing declaration.
beginner: Using a word that isn't in the dictionary.

name: StackOverflowError
explanation: Method calls piled up until the stack was full.
cause: Recursion without an end condition.
example: int f(int n) { return n <= 1 ? 1 : n * f(n - 1); }
beginner: An endless chain of 'ask the next person'.

name: Undefined variable
explanation: You used a PHP variable that was never set.
cause: Typo, or the variable is defined in another scope.
beginner: Using an unlabelled jar.

name: Call to undefined function
explanation: PHP can't find the function you called.
cause: Typo, missing extension, or file not included.
solution: Include the file that defines it.
beginner: Calling a phone number that doesn't exist.

name: Parse error
explanation: PHP can't read the syntax.
cause: Missing semicolon, bracket or quote.
solution: Check the line reported and the one before.
beginner: A sentence missing punctuation.

name: Declared and not used
explanation: Go doesn't allow unused variables or imports.
cause: A variable or import is never used.
solution: Use _ to ignore a value on purpose.
beginner: A strict teacher who won't accept unused supplies.

name: Nil pointer dereference
explanation: You used a pointer that points to nothing.
cause: The pointer was never set.
solution: Check if p != nil before use.
beginner: A signpost that points nowhere.

name: Borrow of moved value
explanation: You used a value after it was moved to something else.
cause: Rust allows only one owner of a value at a time.
beginner: Giving away your book, then trying to read it.

name: Cannot borrow as mutable
explanation: Rust stopped a change that could cause a conflict.
cause: The variable isn't declared mut, or it is already borrowed.
beginner: Two people editing one page at once.

name: Mismatched types
explanation: The value type differs from the expected type.
cause: For example an i32 given where a String is needed.
beginner: Fitting the wrong plug into a socket.

name: Segmentation fault
explanation: The program touched memory it isn't allowed to use.
cause: A null or invalid pointer, or reading past an array's end.
beginner: Walking into a room you don't have a key for.

name: Undefined reference
explanation: The linker can't find a function's code.
cause: The function is declared but its file or library isn't linked.
beginner: A table of contents entry with no chapter.

name: Not declared in this scope
keywords: was not declared in this scope
explanation: You used a name the compiler hasn't seen yet.
cause: Missing #include, typo, or declared later.
beginner: Using a word before defining it.

name: NoMethodError
explanation: You called a method the object doesn't have.
cause: Often the object is nil or a different type.
beginner: Asking a nil (nothing) to speak.

name: Undefined local variable
explanation: Ruby doesn't know that name.
cause: Typo or variable not set in this scope.
beginner: A nickname nobody has heard.

name: Cannot find module
explanation: Node can't find a package or file you require or import.
cause: Not installed, or the path is wrong.
solution: Check the path (./ for local files).
beginner: A missing ingredient in the pantry.

name: EADDRINUSE
explanation: The port you want is already taken.
cause: Another process or an earlier server run uses that port.
beginner: Two cars trying to park in the same spot.

name: ENOENT
explanation: A file or folder doesn't exist at that path.
cause: Wrong path or the file wasn't created.
beginner: Looking for a page in the wrong book.

name: npm ERESOLVE
explanation: npm found packages with conflicting versions.
cause: Two packages need incompatible versions of a dependency.
solution: As a last resort: npm install --legacy-peer-deps.
beginner: Two recipes needing different oven temperatures.

name: Not a git repository
explanation: Git commands ran in a folder that isn't a repo.
cause: No git init was done, or you're in the wrong folder.
solution: Run git init to start tracking.
beginner: Asking for a save file in a game you haven't started.

name: Merge conflict
explanation: Git couldn't combine two sets of changes.
cause: The same lines were edited in both branches.
solution: Then git add and git commit.
beginner: Two editors rewrote the same sentence.

name: Push rejected
explanation: The remote has commits you don't have.
cause: Someone pushed before you.
beginner: Someone updated the shared doc first.

name: Permission denied (publickey)
explanation: GitHub doesn't accept your credentials.
cause: No SSH key is set up, or the wrong token or password is used.
solution: Add your SSH key to GitHub.
Or use HTTPS with a personal access token.
beginner: A door that doesn't recognize your key.
